ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened lower, with Bitcoin slipping 0.35% to $83,607 and major altcoins all in the red, reflecting continued risk aversion. Despite the dip, Bitcoin briefly rebounded above $83k, while sector‑specific headlines—such as Blur’s shutdown and Binance’s upcoming mining pool exit—add pressure.
